meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: 装上本技能后,Claude 可查询癌症细胞系的基因依赖分数(如 CRISPR Chronos)与背景资料,比较基因在不同癌症中的必需性,筛选合成致死或药物敏感相关的候选基因,并下载处理 DepMap 数据文件。
howto.when: 当用户提到基因、癌症类型或药物,想要验证靶点、寻找合成致死伙伴或分析药物敏感性时,Claude 就会调用该技能查询 DepMap 数据。

say.text: 查一下 KRAS 在肺癌细胞系里的 CRISPR 依赖分数。
say.note: 它会查询 DepMap API 并返回一张分数列表。

say.text: 找一找 BRCA1 突变的细胞系里哪些基因更必需。
say.note: 它会做突变与非突变细胞系间的基因效应对比。

say.text: 看看这个化合物的敏感性跟什么基因组特征相关。
say.note: 它会将药物敏感性与突变等特征关联起来。

howto.what_en: Claude can query DepMap gene dependency scores (e.g., CRISPR Chronos) and cell-line metadata, compare essentiality across cancers, screen for synthetic-lethal/drug-sensitivity candidates, and process downloaded DepMap files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about a gene, cancer type, or drug to validate a target, find synthetic lethal partners, or analyze drug sensitivity/biomarkers — e.g., asking for a gene's dependency score in a cancer type.

say_en.text: Check the CRISPR dependency score for KRAS in lung cancer cell lines.
Find genes that are more essential in BRCA1-mutant cells.
See what genomic features correlate with sensitivity to this compound.
say_en.note: Links PRISM drug data to mutation features.
